regras.title: CHALLENGE RULES
regras.subtitle: Everything you need to know to participate and compete.

participar.section_sub: Six steps to start competing in the Brazilian PZ Championship.

steps.title: Sign up on the site
steps.desc: Create your account at pzrank.com.br. Your registration must be approved by a moderator before it appears in the rank.

steps.title: Install the Official Mod
steps.desc: Subscribe to the "PZCommunityRank" mod on the Steam Workshop and enable it in Project Zomboid. The mod validates your sandbox and records your stats.

steps.title: Install PZ Rank Companion
steps.desc: Companion monitors your saves folder and syncs automatically with the rank. Required for your runs to appear on the site.

steps.title: Use the Official Preset
steps.desc: Start a new game with the "Brasileirão PZ" preset enabled by the mod. The sandbox must be 100% identical to the official settings — any divergence causes automatic disqualification.

steps.title: Sync Automatically
steps.desc: Companion detects when you save the game and syncs the data in the background. Each sync updates days survived, kills, skills and objectives.

steps.title: Track Your Rank
steps.desc: Your position is calculated automatically by score. Visit your player page to see the full history of runs and achievements.

participar.callout_min_version_post: Always keep the mod and Companion updated to avoid sync being blocked.
participar.callout_death_body: Companion detects the death and sends it to the rank automatically. If that doesn't happen, your previous character will block any new sync. Contact the moderation team — a moderator will confirm the death, zero out the previous character's points, and unlock your new run.

conduta.section_sub: The rules governing participation in the Brazilian PZ Championship. Compliance is mandatory.

rules.title: Mandatory Streaming
rules.desc: All participation in the championship must be streamed live in a gameplay stream.

rules.title: YouTube or Twitch as Official Platform
rules.desc: The stream must be done on YouTube or Twitch and remain saved for future audits. Registering a YouTube channel is still required at sign-up, but the stream itself can be done on either platform. On YouTube, streams under 12 hours are archived automatically. If streaming only on Twitch, it is the participant's responsibility to manually save the VOD before it is deleted: non-monetized streamers have only 7 days; Affiliates, 14 days; Partners, Prime and Turbo users, up to 60 days.

rules.title: Official Configuration
rules.desc: It is mandatory to use the game version, Sandbox preset, and Official Mod List defined by the championship. Any change will result in the attempt being invalidated.

rules.title: Allowed Mods
rules.desc: Only mods present in the Official Mod List may be used. Suggestions for new mods must be submitted to the moderation team for review.

rules.title: Cheat Prohibition
rules.desc: It is forbidden to use software, scripts, macros, trainers, cheats, exploits or any resource that grants an unfair advantage during the competition.

rules.title: Match Integrity
rules.desc: It is not allowed to edit saves, restore backups after death, use administrative commands, or modify game files to alter the official experience.

rules.title: Attempt Validation
rules.desc: All matches must be valid according to the championship rules and may be audited by the organization through recordings and information provided by PZ-Rank.

rules.title: Sportsmanship
rules.desc: Participants must maintain a respectful attitude towards other competitors, viewers, and the organizing team. Unsportsmanlike conduct may result in penalties.

rules.title: Penalties
rules.desc: Breaking any rule may result in a warning, invalidation of the attempt, disqualification, or ban, depending on the severity of the infraction.

rules.title: Organization's Decision
rules.desc: In omitted cases or situations not foreseen in these rules, the final decision rests exclusively with the Brasileirão PZ organizing team.

rules.title: Death Registration
rules.desc: Every death must be registered in the rank by Companion. If the death is not detected automatically, the player will be blocked from syncing a new character until a moderator confirms the death — after which the previous character's points are zeroed and the new run can start from scratch.

conduta.footer: Questions or reports? Contact the moderation team via Discord or the championship's social media.
